", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes! Yes!” they shouted down.", "sha256": "515e000fb92c3faf670ecd87f82dbbbeb4efc4778560e4ecca97b5b14001f621", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[869]", "source_html": "

“In God’s name, haste! haste!” cried the Jefe.

They heard splashings and curses from the bottom of the well, and, from the lightening of the strain on the riata, knew that Guillermo had left the bucket and was floundering for the coin.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“Put it in the bucket, good Guillermo,” Rafael called down.", "sha256": "51ceacdc5651dc62750890d264a2ea3f8c7cf842cdc2aa7e7d406939c09fd771", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[874]", "source_html": "

“The double weight might break the riata,” Rafael cautioned.
